company.name: Asserts
company.shortDescription: Asserts is an Observability intelligence platform that transforms your Prometheus metrics into root cause insights.
company.description: Asserts transforms your Prometheus data into root cause insights by adding a layer of intelligence to your native Prometheus ecosystem. There is no need to move your data or incur additional data storage costs.

productsAndServices.description: Analyzes Prometheus and OpenTelemetry metrics, traces, and metadata to build a dynamic entity graph that correlates related application and infrastructure components for root cause identification.
productsAndServices.name: Asserts Correlation Intelligence™

productsAndServices.description: A curated library of PromQL recording and alerting rules that continuously scans time-series data to detect common runtime failure patterns and presents findings in a structured assertion model.
productsAndServices.name: Asserts Knowledge Base™

productsAndServices.description: Processes and compresses high-cardinality Prometheus metrics and traces to retain only essential data, significantly reducing ingestion and long-term storage costs.
productsAndServices.name: Asserts Data Distiller™

productsAndServices.description: An automated analysis tool that correlates metrics, traces, and alerts into a unified dashboard to quickly identify and troubleshoot issues affecting service health and SLOs.
productsAndServices.name: Asserts Intelligent Workbench™

productsAndServices.description: Enables definition, tracking, and alerting on Service Level Objectives (SLOs) based on Prometheus metrics to align monitoring with business objectives and reduce alert noise.
productsAndServices.name: SLO Management and Alerting

aiResearchSummary.text: Asserts is focused on developing systems that enhance observability by automatically monitoring applications and generating insights. Their technology involves creating knowledge graphs to model and correlate data, eliminating the need for manual identification of application components to monitor. This approach allows for flexible deployment across various environments, aligning with Asserts' goal of transforming Prometheus metrics into actionable root cause insights.
